Yone

the Unforgotten
Mid laneTop lane

Yone is a blade-dancing skirmisher who leaves his body to fight as a spirit, then snaps back and repeats the damage. He stacks knock-ups with Mortal Steel and dives teams with Fate Sealed. He's played in mid and top lane, and he scales into a hyper-carry with critical strike items.

When to pick Yone

✓ Safe blind pick

Fairly safe blind: he's mobile and has a shield, so he can play most matchups, though Vex and Katarina are tough.

Pick into

  • Immobile mages he can reach, like Ryze or Aurelion Sol
  • Teams that group tightly, where Fate Sealed hits several enemies
  • Teams with little crowd control
  • Melee lanes he out-ranges with Q, like Yasuo

Avoid into

  • Fear and dash punishers like Vex
  • Skirmishers with resets like Katarina
  • Sustain mids like Vladimir
  • Teams with lots of point-and-click crowd control

Great teammates

MalphiteHis ultimate groups enemies for Yone's R.
DianaHer pull sets up big teamfights.
RellHer engage keeps enemies close for Yone.

Your team needs: Some magic damage and engage, since Yone's damage is mostly physical and he wants others to start fights.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Soul Unbound lets him go in and snap back to safety
  • Fate Sealed pulls multiple enemies together for huge teamfights
  • Mixed damage (physical and magic) makes him hard to itemize against
  • No mana: he can trade and farm as long as he wants

Weaknesses

  • Weak early against ranged bullies
  • Point-and-click crowd control and fear stop his engage
  • Needs critical strike items to scale
  • Easy to punish if he wastes Soul Unbound

Power spikes

  • Level 2-3: Q stacks + W shield let you trade with melee mids.
  • Level 6: Fate Sealed makes your all-in deadly.
  • First item (Immortal Shieldbow): crit and a lifeline shield; you can trade aggressively.
  • Two items (Infinity Edge): your crits hit hard; you start carrying.
  • Three items (Death's Dance): you survive dives and long fights.

Top tips

  • Stacked Q goes over walls: use it to escape ganks.
  • W's cooldown gets shorter with attack speed, so you shield more often late game.
  • Snap back with E before you die: it's a free escape if your body is safe.
  • Fate Sealed pulls enemies together; aim it through the middle of a group.
  • Use Exhaust on assassins who dive you, or on the carry you're killing.
  • Don't use Q3 on minions if a trade is coming.
